english.note: Use this when the sentimental behaviour especially suggests letting emotion override reason.

examples.english: They sentimentally pleaded for their friend, leaving no one to take responsibility.
examples.traditional: 佢感情用事咁幫個朋友求情，搞到成件事冇人負責。
